skill.name: zhihu-content-research
skill.description: 当用户需要做知乎热门话题观察、热门选题参考、关键词研究、竞品内容对比、趋势判断或素材整理时使用。面向内容运营、品牌调研和创作者。
skill.summary: Research Zhihu hot topics and keyword results through SocialDataX, then prepare a source-linked report with explicit coverage limits.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most findings match Markdown backticks, readable Chinese text, or documented SocialDataX authentication and support links rather than malicious behavior. The CLI example runs an unpinned remote npm package with automatic confirmation, creating a supply-chain execution risk in an API-key-bearing environment. No evidence found of prompt injection, embedded credentials, or intentional data exfiltration in the supplied files; external package behavior was not reviewed.

remediation.issue: The CLI examples execute socialdatax-skills@latest through npx -y in an environment containing the API key.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version, verify package provenance and integrity, and require installation approval before execution. Provide only the required credential.

content.user_title: Research Zhihu Topics and Content Opportunities
content.value_statement: Zhihu topic planning requires relevant samples and clear limits on what the results represent. This skill guides SocialDataX retrieval and source-linked content research reports.
actual_capabilities: Guide retrieval of the current Zhihu hot list through the SocialDataX CLI or an available MCP tool.
Search Zhihu by keyword with content-type, publication-time, and sorting filters.
Bound search collection with page and item limits, then continue with returned pagination tokens.
Prepare research reports with sample titles, content angles, visible engagement signals, and source references.
Handle partial results by retaining collected items and resuming within the original retrieval limits.
Distinguish local execution failures, API errors, and insufficient-balance responses.
limitations: Requires a SocialDataX API key, provider access, and sufficient account balance for chargeable requests.
CLI use requires Node.js, npm, and network access; MCP use requires the corresponding tools to be available.
Search results cover only the selected query and returned pages, not all Zhihu content.
Provides read-only research guidance; it does not log in, publish, like, comment, or modify accounts.

use_cases.title: Plan relevant topics
use_cases.description: Review current hot topics and related samples to select content angles supported by visible audience interest.

use_cases.title: Compare competitor content
use_cases.description: Search brand and competitor keywords under consistent filters, then compare sampled titles, angles, and visible engagement.

use_cases.title: Build an editorial research brief
use_cases.description: Collect a bounded topic sample and prepare a source-linked brief with scope limits and follow-up questions.

prompt_templates.title: Review the current hot list
prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve the current Zhihu hot list. Summarize relevant topics, preserve available source references, and distinguish observed signals from recommendations.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: inspect current topics without a keyword search.

prompt_templates.title: Research one keyword
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Zhihu for [keyword] using one page and at most 10 items. Summarize relevant titles, authors, available links, and content angles.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: collect a small, focused research sample.

prompt_templates.title: Compare two brands
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [brand A] and [brand B] in Zhihu answers published this month. Use upvote sorting and at most 20 items per keyword.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: compare sampled content under matching filters.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a bounded research report
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [topic] with three keyword variants. Limit each query to two pages and 30 items. Preserve sources, label partial results, and propose follow-up questions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinate multiple bounded searches and report coverage limits.

output_examples.input: Show the format of a brief for one page of Zhihu keyword results.
output: Illustrative format only; no live results are represented.
Scope: selected keyword, one returned page, and the requested item limit.
Samples: returned titles, authors, available source links, and visible engagement signals.
Assessment: relevant content angles and follow-up questions, limited to the retrieved sample.

output_examples.input: Explain how the report should present a search that stopped after returning partial results.
output: Status: incomplete. Preserve the retrieved samples and the reported error.
Coverage: state the collected page and item counts without claiming complete results.
Continuation: after resolving the error, resume only with a nonempty continuation token and remaining retrieval allowance.
Stopping rule: do not restart automatically when the continuation token is empty.

best_practices: Start with one page and a small item limit, then expand only when the sample supports further research.
Preserve source references, query filters, retrieval scope, and partial-result warnings in every research brief.
Use a reviewed, pinned CLI package version and keep the API key in the environment, not prompts or reports.
anti_patterns: Treating a keyword sample or current hot list as complete coverage of Zhihu or proof of a long-term trend.
Restarting partial searches from the first page or repeatedly retrying insufficient-balance errors.
Executing unreviewed latest-package commands automatically or exposing the API key in shared output.

faq.question: What do I need before using this skill?
faq.answer: Configure SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY and provider access. CLI execution also needs Node.js, npm, and network access.

faq.question: Can I use MCP instead of the CLI?
faq.answer: Yes, when zhihu_get_hot_list and zhihu_search_content are already available. The hot-list tool does not take a keyword.

faq.question: Which search filters are documented?
faq.answer: The skill documents content type, sorting, publication time, page count, item limits, and continuation tokens.

faq.question: Does this skill change my Zhihu account?
faq.answer: The documented workflow is read-only. It excludes login, posting, likes, comments, account changes, and local browser data access.

faq.question: Are search results complete?
faq.answer: No. Results cover the selected query and returned pages. Search has no stable complete-result boundary and does not support an all-results option.

faq.question: What happens when requests fail or balance is insufficient?
faq.answer: Preserve partial data and errors. Stop repeated balance retries, resolve the account issue, and resume with a valid continuation token within remaining limits.
